faq.q: Do I need a technical background?
faq.a: No. This is about product craft in an AI context — how AI changes discovery, evaluation, and decision-making. We'll figure out exactly which technical concepts you need for your target roles, not a full ML curriculum.

faq.q: I'm already a PM — is this still useful?
faq.a: Yes. A lot of experienced PMs know product but not how AI reshapes the role. We focus on the delta: what's genuinely different and how to position your existing experience.

faq.q: Will you review my resume for AI roles?
faq.a: We can talk positioning on the call, but a full rewrite is better handled by the Resume Review service, which I can point you to.

faq.q: Can this lead to ongoing help?
faq.a: Definitely. Many people start here and continue with recurring 1:1 Guidance as they make the move.
